changes.after: At a common timestamp finish an otherwise legal support-transfer/door operation first only if all its actual prerequisites remain available through completion. Then resolve resource expiry and unmet control requirements, then ordinary Falling deadlines. A transfer cannot finish after its supporting hull or required mechanism has already been destroyed. No later Action retroactively avoids an impact. Exactly enough fuel to cover an interval supplies power through that interval’s endpoint, allowing its legal completed transfer to resolve before the resulting zero-fuel loss.
